description.value: Pacific Point Market is Powell River's locally owned neighbourhood corner market, operating full-service deli, butcher, bakery, fresh produce, seafood, and dairy departments under one roof. The store participates in the 100 Mile Challenge, actively sourcing meat, dairy, and produce from local BC suppliers to reduce food miles and support regional growers. A touring cyclist arriving in Powell River will find a well-stocked resupply point with deli sandwiches, ready-to-go meals, fresh-baked goods, and Serious Coffee.

address.value: 7013 Thunder Bay St, Powell River, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pacificpointmarket.com provides strong primary evidence: a full-service neighbourhood market at 7013 Thunder Bay St, Powell River, BC (phone 604-489-9111) with bakery, deli, meat, produce, dairy, and grocery departments, confirming the Groceries category. Basic groceries are unambiguously confirmed; hot food is supported by deli ready-to-go meals and in-store Serious Coffee service. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: Website copyright is 2015 and several features (delivery schedule, events) appear unfinished or never launched, suggesting site content may not be fully current.
OSM tags this as 'shop=convenience' but it operates as a full neighbourhood grocery market — the Groceries category assignment is correct and the OSM tag understates the business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service neighbourhood grocery market in Powell River with deli, bakery, produce, and prepared food — a clear and practical resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

Hot food.detail: Deli offers ready-to-go meals, signature sandwiches, and sides; Serious Coffee (freshly roasted Arabica) served in-store

wow_evidence: locally owned neighbourhood corner market … participates in the 100 Mile Challenge
